facts.text: Grand Hyatt Shenzhen is in the heart of the city, within its established commercial and financial district.
facts.excerpt: Grand Hyatt Shenzhen is ideally located in the heart of the city, within the city’s established commercial and financial district.

facts.text: The hotel is just minutes from the Luohu, Futian and Liantang border crossings, giving easy access between Shenzhen and Hong Kong.
facts.excerpt: Just minutes from the Luohu, Futian and Liantang border crossings, the property offers seamless access between Shenzhen and Hong Kong.

facts.text: The hotel sits directly above a major transportation hub served by five intersecting metro lines.
facts.excerpt: Situated directly above a major transportation hub served by five intersecting metro lines

facts.text: The MixC Shopping Mall is adjacent to the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Plenty of dining and shopping options are nearby, including the MixC Shopping Mall that’s adjacent to the hotel.

facts.text: The hotel is housed in a distinctive 38-storey crested building.
facts.excerpt: Grand Hyatt Shenzhen is housed in a distinctive 38-storey crested building.

facts.text: All rooms and suites have floor-to-ceiling windows with Shenzhen city views and Hong Kong mountain views.
facts.excerpt: all with floor-to-ceiling windows, offering magnificent Shenzhen city view and Hong Kong mountain view

facts.text: Standard rooms have a glass-enclosed marble bath with rain shower and separate tub.
facts.excerpt: glass-enclosed marble bath with rain shower and separate tub

facts.text: The hotel offers apartments, including a two-bedroom apartment with a fully equipped kitchen and Grand Club access.
facts.excerpt: Additional living spaces include a living room, dining area, study, and fully equipped kitchen.

facts.text: The Chairman Suite has a dining table for 10, a full kitchen and a private massage area.
facts.excerpt: plus living room, dining table for 10, full kitchen and private massage area

facts.text: The Grand Club offers Club room and suite guests breakfast, afternoon tea, evening cocktails and a selection of wines.
facts.excerpt: Exclusive privileges include gourmet breakfast, afternoon tea, evening cocktails and a selection of sparkling, red and white wines.

facts.text: The heated pool is on the 3rd-floor terrace and has a sun deck.
facts.excerpt: The heated pool at Grand Hyatt Shenzhen is located on our 3rd-floor terrace and features a sun deck

facts.text: Shui Xiang Spa offers massages, facials and body treatments.
facts.excerpt: a refreshing array of services, including massages, facials and body treatments

facts.text: The 24-hour fitness centre includes a foot reflexology and hydrotherapy area, a yoga studio and a steam room.
facts.excerpt: our 24-hour fitness centre, which includes a foot reflexology and hydrotherapy area, cardio machines with LCD screens, a yoga studio, relaxation lounge and steam room

facts.text: The Show Kitchen on the 32nd floor has floor-to-ceiling windows with views of both Shenzhen and Hong Kong and five open kitchens.
facts.excerpt: Its bright panoramic floor-to-ceiling windows offer breathtaking views of both Shenzhen and Hong Kong

facts.text: China Lodge is a Cantonese restaurant on the 35th to 37th floors with panoramic views of Shenzhen.
facts.excerpt: China Lodge, a high-end Cantonese cuisine restaurant, is located on the 35th to 37th floors of Grand Hyatt Hotel in Shenzhen. Here, guests can enjoy an excellent panoramic view of the beautiful scenery of Shenzhen.

facts.text: The Lounge on the 33rd floor looks out over the Shenzhen cityscape and the green mountains of northern Hong Kong.
facts.excerpt: showcasing the vibrant cityscape of Shenzhen on the left and the lush green mountain scenery of the northern Hong Kong region on the right

facts.text: Self-parking is complimentary for hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary for hotel guests

facts.text: For international guests, the hotel recommends local mapping apps such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map, as international mapping apps may not be accurate in Chinese Mainland.
facts.excerpt: we recommend using local mapping applications such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map. International mapping apps may not be accurate in Chinese Mainland.

facts.text: Guests must wear a swimming cap in the pool, per Shenzhen Health Bureau regulations.
facts.excerpt: All guests must wear a swimming cap while in the pool, per Shenzhen Health Bureau regulations.

facts.text: Certain room amenities are discontinued or available only on request as part of the hotel's sustainability commitment.
facts.excerpt: As part of our commitment to sustainability, certain room amenities are discontinued or only available upon request.

facts.text: Grand Hyatt Shenzhen was recognized in the Condé Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards 2023 and 2025.
facts.excerpt: Readers' Choice Awards 2023, 2025
